headlines.title: 央行：二季度末金融机构人民币各项贷款余额282.63万亿元
headlines.summary: 7月28日，中国人民银行公布数据显示，2026年二季度末，金融机构人民币各项贷款余额282.63万亿元，同比增长5.2%，上半年人民币贷款增加10.72万亿元。企事业单位贷款增长平稳，工业中长期贷款总体平稳增长，普惠小微贷款保持增长，绿色贷款稳步增长，涉农贷款增长较为平稳，房地产贷款有所放缓，贷款支持科创企业力度保持稳定，住户经营性贷款同比小幅增长。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: PBOC: By end of Q2, total RMB loans outstanding at financial institutions stood at 282.63 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the People's Bank of China (PBOC) released data showing that at the end of Q2 2026, financial institutions' total RMB loans stood at 282.63 trillion yuan, up 5.2% year-on-year, with an increase of 10.72 trillion yuan in H1. Loans to enterprises and public institutions grew steadily; medium- and long-term industrial loans rose generally steadily; inclusive small and micro loans maintained growth; green loans grew steadily; agricultural loans grew relatively steadily; real estate loans slowed; loan support for tech-innovation firms remained stable; household operating loans saw a slight year-on-year increase. (CCTV)

headlines.title_en: PBOC: By end of Q2, medium- and long-term industrial loans in domestic and foreign currencies totaled 27.81 trillion yuan, up 5.9% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC reported that at the end of Q2 2026, domestic and foreign currency medium- and long-term industrial loans totaled 27.81 trillion yuan, up 5.9% year-on-year, 0.8 percentage points higher than total loan growth, with an increase of 1.21 trillion yuan in H1. Among these, heavy industry medium- and long-term loans were 23.45 trillion yuan, up 4.9% year-on-year; light industry medium- and long-term loans were 4.36 trillion yuan, up 11.3% year-on-year. Medium- and long-term service sector loans excluding real estate grew 9.2% year-on-year; real estate medium- and long-term loans fell 4.2% year-on-year. headlines.summary: 中国央行发布2026年二季度金融机构贷款投向统计报告。报告提到，2026年二季度末，人民币房地产贷款余额50.74万亿元，同比下降4.9%，上半年减少1.23万亿元。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: By end of Q2, RMB real estate loans outstanding stood at 50.74 trillion yuan, down 4.9% year-on-year

headlines.title_en: PBOC: By end of Q2, household loans in domestic and foreign currencies totaled 82.91 trillion yuan, down 1.3% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC reported that at the end of Q2 2026, domestic and foreign currency household loans totaled 82.91 trillion yuan, down 1.3% year-on-year, with a decrease of 367.4 billion yuan in H1. Among these, operating loans were 25.79 trillion yuan, up 2.8% year-on-year, with an increase of 688.9 billion yuan in H1. Consumer loans excluding personal housing loans were 20.83 trillion yuan, down 1.7% year-on-year, with a decrease of 340 billion yuan in H1.

headlines.title_en: PBOC: By end of Q2, RMB inclusive micro- and small-enterprise loans outstanding stood at 38.52 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC reported that at the end of Q2 2026, RMB inclusive small and micro loans totaled 38.52 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year-on-year, 3.1 percentage points higher than total loan growth, with an increase of 1.95 trillion yuan in H1. Household operating loans for farmers with single-account credit under 5 million yuan were 10.21 trillion yuan, with an increase of 399.8 billion yuan in H1. Student loans were 350.9 billion yuan, up 31.1% year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai HQ of PBOC: In H1, RMB deposits in the Yangtze River Delta region increased by 4.67 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC Shanghai Head Office released H1 2026 monetary and credit operations in the Yangtze River Delta region. At end-June, domestic and foreign currency deposits in the region totaled 91.89 trillion yuan, up 8.3% year-on-year. Among these, RMB deposits were 88.8 trillion yuan, up 8.2% year-on-year; foreign currency deposits were $454.5 billion, up 14.4% year-on-year.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际表示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产非本地买家中最大的群体，因香港写字楼板块低迷导致不良资产价格大幅回调，吸引了这些投资者。鉴于写字楼资产价格的走势，未来几个月新加坡的需求有望保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Claims that China's insufficient domestic demand leads to overcapacity are not consistent with facts
headlines.summary_en: In response to the claim that 'insufficient domestic demand in China leads to overcapacity,' Lin Weilong, Director of the Policy Research Office of the Ministry of Commerce, stated that this view does not align with facts. China is both a major manufacturing and consumption nation. Domestic demand has always been the main engine of China's economy, contributing an average of 93% to economic growth from 2013 to 2024, with consumption and investment contributing 55% and 38%, respectively. China's total retail sales of consumer goods doubled from 23.8 trillion yuan in 2013 to 50.1 trillion yuan in 2025. Converted by World Bank purchasing power parity, China's total retail sales were approximately 1.7 times that of the US in 2025, making it the world's largest commodity consumer market. headlines.title_en: He Lifeng attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 2026 APEC Meeting of Ministers Responsible for Forestry
headlines.summary_en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry in Shenzhen on the 28th. He Lifeng emphasized that the Asia-Pacific is one of the regions with the richest forest resources and most diverse ecosystem types, accounting for over half of the world's forests. China is committed to maintaining global ecological security, spreading ecological culture and green concepts, and contributing Chinese wisdom and solutions to ecological civilization in the Asia-Pacific and globally. Through joint efforts, the Asia-Pacific has become a major force reversing the global decline in forest resources. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 商务部：中国从不刻意追求贸易顺差
headlines.summary: 国新办就所谓“产能过剩”问题中方立场有关情况举行新闻发布会。商务部对外贸易司负责人贺少军表示，中国从不刻意追求贸易顺差，我们将继续积极推动进出口平衡发展，持续向全世界开放市场，坚定不移扩大进口。今年上半年，中国货物贸易进口增速为22.1%，明显快于出口。中国稳居全球第二大进口市场，超大规模的市场需求为贸易伙伴提供了强劲发展动力。特别是去年以来，我们打造“出口中国”品牌，计划每年举办超过100场进口促进活动，致力于与全球共享中国发展新机遇。在多国举办的“出口中国”境外活动上，许多中国企业与当地企业签订意向采购合同，拓宽了进口采购来源，为各国企业进入中国市场

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China never deliberately pursues a trade surplus
headlines.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on China's stance on the so-called 'overcapacity' issue, He Shaojun, an official of the Ministry of Commerce's Department of Foreign Trade, stated that China never deliberately pursues a trade surplus. It will continue to promote balanced development of imports and exports, open its market to the world, and steadfastly expand imports. In H1 2026, China's goods trade import growth was 22.1%, significantly faster than exports. China remains the world's second-largest import market, and its vast market demand provides strong momentum for trading partners. Since last year, it launched the 'Export to China' brand, planning to hold over 100 import promotion events annually, sharing new development opportunities with the world. At overseas 'Export to China' events in many countries, Chinese companies signed intention procurement contracts with local firms, broadening import sources and providing access to the Chinese market.

headlines.title_en: Urban land use tax policies for companies in certain energy and resource industries will be adjusted
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration issued a notice on July 28 clarifying adjustments to the urban land use tax policy for some enterprises in energy resources industries. headlines.title: 商务部谈贸易顺差：处于国际公认合理范围内，并未出现显著国际收支失衡
headlines.summary: 商务部对外贸易司负责人贺少军表示，顺差反映出国际分工的深刻演变。回顾全球经济发展史，各国在工业化进程中普遍经历了贸易顺差的阶段，英国、美国、日本、德国等制造强国都曾长期保持贸易顺差。从行业产品看，美国芯片80%用于出口，波音公司交付的商用飞机约2/3销往北美以外的客户。欧盟的汽车、药品、化妆品，2025年顺差分别为922亿、2146亿和116亿美元。出口多、顺差大不等于产能过剩。中国实现贸易顺差，反映出中国的产业体系完备高效，是全球分工体系和贸易格局变化的客观结果。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Trade surplus remains within internationally recognized reasonable range, no significant balance of payments imbalance
headlines.summary_en: He Shaojun, an official of the Ministry of Commerce's Department of Foreign Trade, stated that trade surpluses reflect the deep evolution of the international division of labor. Reviewing global economic history, countries generally experienced trade surpluses during industrialization, including manufacturing powers like the UK, US, Japan, and Germany. By industry, 80% of US chips are for export, and about two-thirds of Boeing's commercial aircraft deliveries are to non-North American customers. In 2025, the EU's surpluses in automobiles, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics were $92.2 billion, $214.6 billion, and $11.6 billion, respectively. High exports and large surpluses do not equate to overcapacity. China's trade surplus reflects its complete and efficient industrial system, an objective outcome of changes in the global division of labor and trade patterns.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: EU's hype over RMB exchange rate issue is not conducive to the stable development of China-EU economic and trade relations
headlines.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference to present China's stance on the so-called 'overcapacity' issue. A journalist on site asked: Recently, some leaders from EU countries and institutions have expressed concerns that the Chinese currency is undervalued, giving Chinese exporters an unfair advantage. What is the Ministry of Commerce's response? Looking ahead to the second half of this year, especially amid ongoing trade tensions and the overall economic backdrop, how does the Ministry view China-EU trade prospects? Lin Weilong, Director of the Policy Research Office of the Ministry of Commerce, responded at the meeting. In recent years, under the strategic guidance of leaders from both sides, China-EU economic and trade relations have generally developed well. In the first half of this year, total goods trade between China and the EU increased by 14.2% year-on-year, reaching $447.88 billion. Both sides have significant cooperation potential in areas such as services trade, technological innovation, and the green economy.
